user.description: Enter your Textbelt API key. If you need help, visit: {docs_url}.

error.connection: Unable to connect to Textbelt API.

init.description: Enter one international phone number per line, including + and country code. Notification recipients do not authorize Assist. Native SMS Assist is disabled by default and needs a separate authorized sender list and a public HTTPS Home Assistant external URL. The preferred pipeline follows Home Assistant changes on every turn. Conversation inactivity timeout must be 1 to 86400 seconds (default 1800). Disable old SMS-to-Assist automations before enabling native replies to avoid duplicate responders.

error.invalid_recipient: Use one explicit international number per line (+ and up to 15 ASCII digits). Extensions are not supported.
error.authorized_sender_required: Add at least one authorized Assist sender.
error.invalid_pipeline: Select an existing Assist pipeline or the preferred pipeline.
error.invalid_callback_url: Configure a public HTTPS Home Assistant external URL without credentials, query parameters, or a fragment.
error.invalid_timeout: Use an integer from 1 to 86400 seconds.
error.invalid_reply_key: Native Assist requires a non-free, reply-capable Textbelt key.
